enabled.description: Clax on or off on this site.

launcher.description: The floating Report and Your reports buttons in the corner.

targets.description: Elements marked data-clax="report" (or "reports"), and the `targets` selectors, start Clax.

key.description: A key that starts a report (such as "f"); empty for none. Never heard in a text field or with a modifier.

palette.description: "Send feedback" and "Your reports" are offered to the site's command palette (handle.actions()).

link.description: ?clax=report (or reports) in the page's address starts Clax on load.

targets.description: More elements that start Clax: a selector each, and its action.

presentation.description: How the composer is shown: floating in the corner, a dialog, a side drawer, a bottom sheet, its own window, or the installed Clax extension (a dialog when it is not installed).

render.description: Clax pages (a report, its thread, Your reports) drawn by the SDK in the site's theme, or embedded from Clax.

start.description: What a report starts with: the note, a screenshot of the page, or picking an element.

screenshot.description: A screenshot can be attached (off: capture is never downloaded).

errors.description: The page's recent errors start ticked.

logs.description: The app's log lines (from the site's log source) start ticked.

browser.description: The browser, platform, language and time zone are sent.

annotate.description: The reporter can draw on the screenshot.

code-blur.description: Code on the page is blurred in screenshots.

code-selector.description: What counts as code, for the blur.

code-line.description: A pick in code records its file and lines (from the site's code locator).

pins.description: Reports are pinned on what they are about.

logs.description: The page's global (a dotted path) giving its recent log lines.

release.description: The page's global giving the app version: {version, commit?} or a string.

user.description: The page's global naming the signed-in person.

intro.description: The dialog's opening paragraph: whose operators read it, where it goes, which identity it is sent with, what is always sent.

retention.description: The line by the Send button on how long reports are kept.

reports-label.description: The label of the link or button to the reporter's reports.

reports-url.description: Where the reports link goes (an https URL, opened in a new tab); empty: the reports open in the dialog's own view.

viewer.description: Whether a viewer's cookie override applies: on local and tailnet origins only, everywhere, or nowhere. Never itself overridden by the cookie.
